name: venues
description: Halls, rooms and spaces booked for events and meetings.

capacity.description: How many people the space holds at most.

howDealsGo: The booking is paid into escrow and released after the event; a deposit for damage is a second escrow, released back. A timer to the seller on the booking, set past the event, pays for an event that happened if the buyer goes quiet, and a timer to the buyer on the deposit brings it back. Before paying, visit the space and agree what is included: chairs, cleaning, sound.
